stories.title: Allowlist Schema & Request Contract Definition
stories.description: Define the formal allowlist schema and request contract for GPTReader including permitted collections, fields, operators, limits, and query shapes. Implement Pydantic models to enforce strict validation at deserialization time.

stories.title: Rejection Handling and Audit Logging for Violations
stories.description: Implement standardized rejection responses and structured audit logging for all blocked requests including reason codes, request metadata, and caller identity to support traceability and security review.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration with Brain Auth Scope Controls
stories.description: Integrate server-side allowlist enforcement with Brain authentication and scope-based access control to ensure requests are validated against both structural allowlist rules and caller authorization scopes.
